category_title: At-risk students in technical tracks who exhibit attention-seeking behaviors, restlessness, and kinetic learning needs
minimal_context: The student is learning basic keyboard chord playing using video demonstrations and handouts in a keyboard lab.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please watch this video demonstration on how to play the chords on the keyboard, and read the handout with the letter names so you know what keys to play.

STUDENT: (Cannot stop touching the keyboard) Miss, Miss, how to play?

TUTOR: Just listen to the instructions and follow along with the video.

STUDENT: (Becomes restless and opens a PC game on the computer) I'm having a hard time following the chord changes.

TUTOR: Please close the game and pay attention to the instructions.

STUDENT: (Decides to play the keyboard really loudly) I don't want to listen to instructions!

options.A: Ask the student to explain their understanding of the chords using the keyboard.
options.B: Match the student with a more advanced peer to practice the keyboard chords.
options.C: Announce an individual testing session for playing the keyboard chords.
options.D: Encourage the student to rely on the handouts and videos rather than the tutor.
